purpose: Independent finite execution-trace acceptance for event-indexed Clinic obligations.

semantics.identity_binding: Normalize actual feedback only after checking the event, protocol task, robot, revision and attempt. An E1 receipt must not update E2 propositions.
semantics.clock: Use the actual Clinic episode clock for ordering; do not mix worker ROS timestamps with episode timestamps.
semantics.monitor_active: Retain the actual event-specific monitor obligation across plan revisions. Predicted finish, evidence TTL expiry and a cancellation request are not a release ACK.
semantics.fall_confirmed: Requires explicit event-bound verification evidence. Verify service success alone does not establish this proposition.
semantics.response_complete: Requires this event actual verify, pickup, delivery, handover and monitor completion evidence; predicted schedule times are insufficient.
semantics.handover_done: Requires this event explicit actual receiver evidence after actual delivery; it is never synthesized from delivery success.
semantics.event_cancelled_safe: Requires an explicit supported terminal cancellation path. Unsupported active monitor or cargo transfers must not establish this fact.
semantics.version_inheritance: A new plan revision preserves monitor instances, latched facts and outstanding obligations. It does not reset an event automaton.
semantics.prefix_handling: Truncated or still-running traces retain INCONCLUSIVE obligations. A prediction-only input is not an actual execution trace.
semantics.coverage: Report triggering coverage separately; a rule that never triggers is not evidence that its response behavior was exercised.
unsupported: Inferring three-dimensional human position from a registered video region
Treating MILP forecasts as actual execution or actual event closure
